svg.title: Robonix architecture
svg.desc: The user talks to Liaison, which verifies the user with Keystone; Pilot sends the task to an LLM or VLM, which orchestrates skills and services by writing RTDL programs, which Executor runs under Sentinel's supervision. Custom services such as navigation and speech sit beside Scene. Soma, at the bottom, is the body abstraction: a URDF gives the body's geometry and frames, and a YAML body description gives its component tree and the primitive capabilities each component provides to drive the hardware. The skill library runs down the right side from the services into Soma; the preset skills, such as a dance or a backflip, sit where the two overlap. Skills can be learned in a simulator such as Webots, MuJoCo, or Isaac Sim and then deployed to real robots through Robonix.
svg.text: Orchestrates skills for each natural-language task
body model described in URDF and YAML
quadruped · wheeled · tracked · humanoid · arm and hand
